_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Qanmi Player {player_id} kanki {num_players}-pukllaykachaq Liar's Dice pukllaypi.
Kamachikuna:
- Q'umir turnoykita, qanmi:
  1) Musuq bid ruwayta, aswan yupayninman aswan face (manañachu) kunan bidmanta; ahinataq '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Q'ipiyta q'umir bidta '[Call]' qillqaspa.

Q'ipiyta q'umir q'ipiykachaq:
  - Wakichi yupaykunapaq yupaynin mana yupasqa bidmanta, q'ipiykachaq pask'arqan huk wakichita.
  - Mana, q'ipiykachaq pask'arqan huk wakichita.
Pukllaykachaq 0 wakichi yupaykunayuq pask'arqan, atipaqmi.

board.new_round:
Ukhu p'unchay - Mana k'usillu: {dice_summary}
Kamayuq k'usilluq kan: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Pukllaykachaq {current_player_id} q'ipiyta! Wakichi yupaykunapaq yupaynin {face_value} {count}, mana yupasqa {quantity}.
Pukllaykachaq {loser_id} (q'ipiykachaq) pask'arqan huk wakichita.
call.caller_loses:
Runa {current_player_id} riman! {face_value} ñawpaq q'ipin {count}mi, {quantity}manta aswanmi.
Runa {loser_id} (rimaq) huk t'uru p'unchawn.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Mana ni uj ofertawanchu, chayman chayan.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Accion mana riqsichu '[Bid: X, Y]' icha '[Call]' nisqataq. Apukun accion: {action}

bid_reason.face_lower: Ukhu face willay {new_face_value} aswan p'isqaqa kunan {current_face_value}.

message.eliminated_invalid: Pichu pukllaq {player_id} mana allin puriywan lluqsirqan.
